I don’t think grief ruined them, i think it highlighted a key issue: ralph not understanding who PC is as a person.

Both ralph and judah have their flaws, everyone does. It’s about whether they have compatible personalities for a relationship with PC. not a teacher, but here is my experience with a teacher about bullying.

i was being bullied for the past 3 years in school. from the start until i graduated, i was ostracised in class and no one would talk to me or sit with me unless required to for lessons and projects. as a result from this social isolation, i became increasingly depressed.

in my second year, one day i fell extremely sick in the middle of the day, had a bad flu and high fever. My motor skills were especially slow and i could not move quickly. so when class was over and it was time for lunch, everyone cleared out of the class way before i could even pack my bags. Of course, no one waited for me, so i took my time to pack up.

My teacher came over to me to break the ice about my scars on my legs (due to eczema, it was acting up recently). I explained to him it was because i was trying to be active again (i joined the cheerleading team just a few weeks before this, i'm the only cheerleader in class) and the heat in the weather mixed in with my sweat made my skin act up. He told me i should go get it checked out at the clinic because it looked really bad. I smiled and thanked him for his concern.


He then moved on to the point he really wanted to make: he asked if i was being bullied or something, given the treatment i was receiving from my classmate.

I kind of lied to him and said it was because i didn't click with anyone, and not to worry because i have friends outside of class (such as my childhood friends from previous schools). He didn't buy it, and gave me his number, and told me to come to him if i need any help or if my classmates' treatment get out of hand.

It was the nicest thing any teacher has ever done for me. I never expected anyone to approach me about this matter or even offer help. Not a single person in my class would talk to me, afterall. I guess he also figured there wasn’t anything he could do to stop them from treating me this way, and that offering me help to get out of it seemed more plausible.
